about: Rights per user profile. Read by the FastAPI back end (fastapi_contract/permissions.py), which enforces them and returns the resolved list in GET /api/me, and by the front end in sample-data mode. Every user has one profile; roles add rights on top. A profile can extend another one. Add a permission to the catalogue before using it in a profile or role.

permissions.explorer.view: Open the Explorer and browse the Watchlist
permissions.reports.quick: Download the Comparison report (PDF / HTML) from the Explorer toolbar
permissions.custom.view: See custom series in the Explorer, Dashboard and reports
permissions.custom.manage: Create, edit, tag and delete custom series and custom series folders
permissions.import.excel: Import Excel data for this session (Dashboard and reports)
permissions.folders.personal: Create personal folders and sub-folders, fill them, set personal benchmarks
permissions.watchlist.manage: Add and remove Watchlist instruments, create and delete Watchlist folders, set Watchlist folder benchmarks
permissions.benchmarks.security: Set an instrument's benchmark for all users

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Maintains the Watchlist and shared benchmarks
